i.norm: Verifies that a colon-delimited string with surrounding whitespace is tokenized correctly: whitespace is trimmed from each token, empty tokens are kept (not ignored) but returned as null. Input "a: b : " splits on ':' into three raw parts: "a", " b ", " ". After trimming: "a", "b", "" — the trailing empty string becomes null due to emptyTokenAsNull=true.
